newsitem.title: USA: BSB Bancorp names president DePersis CEO.
newsitem.headline: BSB Bancorp names president DePersis CEO.

text.p: BSB Bancorp Inc said Thursday that President Alex DePersis has been named chief executive of the company and its subsidiary, BSB Bank & Trust Co.
DePersis, who has named president and chief operating officer in 1995, succeeds William Rincker, who has retired as chairman and chief executive.
The management change took place January 1.
It was not immediately known if a new chairman had been named. Rincker will continue to serve as a board member of BSB Bancorp and BSB Bank & Trust, the company said.
A company spokeswoman said later Thursday that a new chairman has not been named.
